metanarrative_source: Georg supplied HyperNorm brief and prior authoring context;canonical remote lore reread deferred as documented in Return;no canon approval inferred

records.name: Vera Refresh
records.biography_en: Vera measures HyperNorm afternoons in the time between reactions to her latest post. The Men in Black value observable approval. A dissonant card arrived without a response button. She answered it by visiting the neighbour who sent it and found the silence less alarming in company.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: Approval is expected shortly. She has refreshed the expectation.

records.name: Ollie Outrage
records.biography_en: Ollie patrols the HyperNorm feed for unacceptable remarks and acceptable opportunities to object. Hunky and Dory keep the supply reliable. A contradictory card made him angry at something he had said himself. He has not advertised the discovery, but his next apology was addressed to a person.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: The matter is urgent. Its contents may be replaced without notice.

records.name: Felix Filter
records.biography_en: Felix arranges his HyperNorm reflection before allowing a photograph to become evidence. The Men in Black appreciate a consistent face. An ambiguous card asked what the neighbour would recognise without the adjustments. He kept one unedited picture, mostly because the neighbour looked happy in it.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: He is being entirely himself. Preparation took some time.

records.name: Mabel Mutual
records.biography_en: Mabel follows every HyperNorm gathering while worrying about the one happening elsewhere. Hunky and Dory promise there is always another. A dissonant card asked where she actually wanted to be. She spent a quiet evening with one neighbour and did not send proof until the next morning.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: She is somewhere. The difficulty is everywhere else.

records.name: Lenny Lurker
records.biography_en: Lenny reads the HyperNorm discussion without leaving a trace except a growing certainty that others are foolish. The Men in Black approve his careful observation. A contradictory card contained a question he genuinely wanted answered. His first reply was brief and rather kinder than his rehearsals.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: He has nothing to add. His opinion remains extensive.

records.name: Barry Broadcast
records.biography_en: Barry broadcasts HyperNorm errands as though an audience were waiting at every corner. Hunky and Dory encourage regular updates. A dissonant card asked him to put the phone down while helping a neighbour. He did, and later found the story difficult to explain without making himself the point.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: The moment has been shared. Presence is still being negotiated.
